entries.title: John 14:1
segments: Do not let your hearts be troubled. Believe in God; believe also in me.

entries.title: John 14:2
segments: In my Father's Home there are many dwellings. If it had not been so, I should have told you, for I am going to prepare a place for you.

entries.title: John 14:3
segments: And, since I go and prepare a place for you, I shall return and take you to be with me, so that you may be where I am;

entries.title: John 14:4
segments: And you know the way to the place where I am going."

entries.title: John 14:5
segments: "We do not know where you are going, Master," said Thomas; "so how can we know the way?"

entries.title: John 14:6
segments: Jesus answered: "I am the Way, and the Truth, and the Life; no one ever comes to the Father except through me.

entries.title: John 14:7
segments: If you had recognized me, you would have known my Father also; for the future you will recognize him, indeed you have already seen him."

entries.title: John 14:8
segments: "Master, show us the Father," said Philip, "and we shall be satisfied."

entries.title: John 14:9
segments: "Have I been all this time among you," said Jesus, "and yet you, Philip, have not recognized me? He who has seen me has seen the Father, how can you say, then, 'Show us the Father'?

entries.title: John 14:10
segments: Do not you believe that I am in union with the Father, and the Father with me? In giving you my teaching I am not speaking on my own authority; but the Father himself, always in union with me, does his own work.

entries.title: John 14:11
segments: Believe me," he said to them all, "when I say that I am in union with the Father and the Father with me, or else believe me on account of the work itself.

entries.title: John 14:12
segments: In truth I tell you, he who believes in me will himself do the work that I am doing; and he will do greater work still, because I am going to the Father.

entries.title: John 14:13
segments: Whatever you ask, in my Name, I will do, that the Father may be honored in the Son.

entries.title: John 14:14
segments: If you ask anything, in my Name, I will do it.

entries.title: John 14:15
segments: If you love me, you will lay my commands to heart,

entries.title: John 14:16
segments: And I will ask the Father, and he will give you another Helper, to be with you always--the Spirit of Truth.

entries.title: John 14:17
segments: The world cannot receive this Spirit, because it does not see him or recognize him, but you recognize him, because he is always with you, and is within you.

entries.title: John 14:18
segments: I will not leave you bereaved; I will come to you.

entries.title: John 14:19
segments: In a little while the world will see me no more, but you will still see me; because I am living, you will be living also.

entries.title: John 14:20
segments: At that time you will recognize that I am in union with the Father, and you with me, and I with you.

entries.title: John 14:21
segments: It is he who has my commands and lays them to heart that loves me; and he who loves me will be loved by my Father, and I will love him, and will reveal myself to him."

entries.title: John 14:22
segments: "What has happened, Master," said Judas (not Judas Iscariot), "that you are going to reveal yourself to us, and not to the world?"

entries.title: John 14:23
segments: "Whoever loves me," Jesus answered," will lay my Message to heart; and my Father will love him, and we will come to him and make our dwelling with him.

entries.title: John 14:24
segments: He who does not love me will not lay my Message to heart; and the Message to which you are listening is not my own, but that of the Father who sent me.

entries.title: John 14:25
segments: I have told you all this while still with you,

entries.title: John 14:26
segments: But the Helper--the Holy Spirit whom the Father will send in my Name--he will teach you all things, and will recall to your minds all that I have said to you.

entries.title: John 14:27
segments: Peace be with you! My own peace I give you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your hearts be troubled, or dismayed.

entries.title: John 14:28
segments: You heard me say that I was going away and would return to you. Had you loved me, you would have been glad that I was going to the Father, because the Father is greater than I.

entries.title: John 14:29
segments: And this I have told you now before it happens, that, when it does happen, you may still believe in me.

entries.title: John 14:30
segments: I shall not talk with you much more, for the Spirit that is ruling the world is coming. He has nothing in common with me;

entries.title: John 14:31
segments: But he is coming that the world may see that I love the Father, and that I do as the Father commanded me. Come, let us be going.
